title: AnkiLabs - AI
description: AI Card Actions calls through the LLM Proxy: outcomes, latency, input size, tokens and cost, with Usage Codes and spend from LiteLLM's database and the matching logs.

panels.title: Read counts first

options.content:
AI Card Actions metrics (Prometheus, **ankilabs** only), LiteLLM's own request records (PostgreSQL, read-only views: Usage Code metadata and spend, never key hashes, prompts or answers) and AI Card Actions logs (Loki). Window counts include a series first seen inside the window, so the first call after a restart is not lost; they can still be fractional. Percentiles need at least 5 calls in their 30-minute window and stay empty otherwise: read them next to counts and means. Latency buckets step 10, 30, 60, 120 s, so upper percentiles are coarse; calls time out at 75 s (`ai_timeout`).

**Outcomes:** an answer LiteLLM returned (HTTP 200) that AI Card Actions rejected (`ai_output_invalid`) is `outcome=error` in these metrics, while its `llm.request.completed` log record says `outcome=success`; its tokens and cost are still counted. `ai_refused` (the model declined; the user gets 422) and Usage Code errors are errors here but are excluded from the error-ratio alert. **Tokens:** reasoning tokens are already part of completion tokens, so a total is prompt + completion, never the sum over every type. **LiteLLM duration** is the proxy's own call time (provider plus proxy); the gap to AI Card Actions' LLM duration is the in-cluster path, and the gap to HTTP duration is AI Card Actions' own work. Missing data is unknown, never zero.

[AI runbook](https://github.com/liav-hasson/homelab/blob/main/k8s/platform/monitoring/runbook.md#ai)

panels.title: Traffic and errors

options.content: LLM calls are one per action request (`sentences`, `notes`, `review`, `speech`) and are never retried. Errors by code keep every code visible; `ai_timeout` is highlighted.

panels.title: LLM calls by action and outcome / 15 minutes

targets.expr: sum by (action, outcome) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} offset 15m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m]))

panels.title: Error ratio by action (alert definition) / 15 minutes
panels.description: Errors over all LLM calls, excluding Usage Code errors and ai_refused, as in AnkiLabsAIErrorRatioHigh (the line is its 20% threshold; it also needs at least 3 calls in 15 minutes). Absent means no calls.

targets.expr: sum by (action) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"} offset 15m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"}[15m])) / (sum by (action) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} offset 15m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m])) > 0)

panels.title: LLM errors by action and error code / 15 minutes (ai_timeout highlighted)

targets.expr: sum by (action, error_code) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset 15m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m]))

panels.title: LLM error counters since process start (not window counts)
panels.description: Raw counters per pod lifetime, for checking window counts against logs.

targets.expr: sum by (action, model, error_code) (ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs"})

panels.title: Scrape health (absent target is unknown)

targets.expr: up{namespace="ankilabs",job="monitoring/ankilabs-ai-card-actions"}

panels.title: Latency

options.content: LLM duration is AI Card Actions' call to the LLM Proxy, until the answer is accepted or rejected. HTTP duration is the whole action request. LiteLLM duration (successful calls only) is the proxy's own record.

panels.title: LLM duration p50 / p95 / p99 by action (30m window, at least 5 calls)
panels.description: Both outcomes; a timeout lands in the 60-120 s bucket. Empty means too few calls, not zero latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

panels.title: Mean LLM duration by action and outcome (30m window)

targets.expr: sum by (action, outcome) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) / (sum by (action, outcome) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) > 0)

panels.title: HTTP duration by route: mean and p95 (30m window, p95 needs 5 requests)
panels.description: End-to-end action requests (/v1 routes; health checks excluded), all statuses.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_http_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="ankilabs",route=~"/v1/.+"}[30m])) / (sum by (route) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs",route=~"/v1/.+"}[30m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs",route=~"/v1/.+"}[30m]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs",route=~"/v1/.+"}[30m])) >= 5

panels.title: LiteLLM duration by model group: mean and p95 (successful calls, 15m buckets)
panels.description: From LiteLLM's spend logs: exact per-call percentiles, not histogram estimates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '15m'), model_group AS metric,
  avg(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS mean,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS p95
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND status = 'success' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Input size

options.content: Characters of user input per LLM call (card text, or the text to speak). Means are per call over 30 minutes; per-request size and duration pairs are in the `llm.request.completed` logs below.

panels.title: Input characters by action: mean and p95 (30m window, p95 needs 5 calls)

targets.expr: sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) / (sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

panels.title: Calls at or below each input size (cumulative buckets, dashboard range)
panels.description: le is the bucket's upper bound in characters; +Inf is every call.

targets.expr: sum by (action, le) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Mean LLM duration vs mean input size by action (30m window)
panels.description: Duration on the left axis, input characters on the right. Moving together suggests size drives latency; confirm per request in the logs.

targets.expr: sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) / (sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) > 0)

sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) / (sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) > 0)

panels.title: ai_timeout calls vs mean input size by action (30m window)
panels.description: Timeouts on the left axis, input characters on the right.

targets.expr: sum by (action) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code="ai_timeout"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code="ai_timeout"} offset 30m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code="ai_timeout"}[30m]))

sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) / (sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_input_chars_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) > 0)

panels.title: Tokens and cost

options.content: As LiteLLM reported them to AI Card Actions, including answers rejected afterwards. Reasoning tokens are a subset of completion tokens. Speech is priced per character and reports no tokens.

panels.title: Tokens by action and type / hour (reasoning is part of completion; do not add it)

targets.expr: sum by (action, type) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset 1h) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[1h]))

panels.title: Cost by action and model / hour

targets.expr: sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset 1h) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[1h]))

panels.title: Cost by action and model (dashboard range)

targets.expr: sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Cost share by action (dashboard range)

targets.expr: sum by (action) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__range])) / on () group_left () (sum ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Tokens by action and model (dashboard range)
panels.description: Total is prompt + completion; reasoning is included in it and shown only for scale.

targets.expr: sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"}[$__range]))

sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type="reasoning"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type="reasoning"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type="reasoning"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Usage Codes and LiteLLM spend

options.content: LiteLLM's database through read-only views (`grafana` schema). Times are UTC in the database and shown in the browser's zone. Spend is what draws down a Usage Code's budget; Authorization's own key is not listed.

panels.title: Usage Codes
panels.description: Current state, not limited to the dashboard range. Last request includes rejected calls.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT key_alias AS "Usage Code", created_at AS "Created", spend AS "Spend",
  max_budget AS "Budget", remaining AS "Remaining", blocked AS "Blocked", expires AS "Expires",
  last_request_at AS "Last request", array_to_string(models, ', ') AS "Models"
FROM grafana.usage_codes
ORDER BY last_request_at DESC NULLS LAST, key_alias

panels.title: LiteLLM spend by Usage Code / hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '1h'), coalesce(key_alias, 'unknown key') AS metric,
  sum(spend) AS value
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND spend > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LiteLLM spend by model group / hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '1h'), model_group AS metric, sum(spend) AS value
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND spend > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LiteLLM calls by model group and status / hour
panels.description: Includes calls LiteLLM rejected itself (invalid, blocked or exhausted Usage Codes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '1h'),
  model_group || ' ' || coalesce(status, 'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest LiteLLM calls (100 in the dashboard range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT start_time AS "Started", key_alias AS "Usage Code", model_group AS "Model group",
  status AS "Status", duration_ms / 1000.0 AS "Duration", prompt_tokens AS "Prompt tokens",
  completion_tokens AS "Completion tokens", spend AS "Spend"
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Logs

options.content: Parsed at query time; request and Usage Code identifiers are never index labels. Log records are not a failure count.

panels.title: LLM call warnings and errors: llm.request.completed and llm.output.rejected
panels.description: Each failed call has one llm.request.completed record (error_code, duration_ms, input_chars); a rejected answer adds llm.output.rejected with its reason.

targets.expr: {namespace="ankilabs",app="ai-card-actions"} | json | event=~"llm.request.completed|llm.output.rejected" | level=~"WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL"

panels.title: AI Card Actions warnings/errors and unparsed records

targets.expr: {namespace="ankilabs",app="ai-card-actions"} | json | level=~"WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL" or __error__!=""
